answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can influence a vote or claim rewards, and cap its influence by the bond rather than by the number of identities it creates. A Sybil attacker can mint aliases named basalt, timber, and ferrous, but each account must lock real value; splitting one stake across many accounts buys no extra weight. The attacker pays in tied-up capital and fees, and risks losing the bond if it breaks the rules.
